volatile_substitutions.rule: datetime.now() is fixture-owned UTC instead of capture wall time
datetime.fromtimestamp() renders in UTC instead of host local time
os.getloadavg() is the fixture triple [1.25, 2.5, 3.75] unless overridden
HOME, USER, PATH lookup, virtual /etc files, and tool presence are fixture-owned
the frozen source __file__ and os.path.abspath(__file__) are /opt/srvls/srvls
stdout, stderr, exit, missing, denied, and timeout outcomes are fixture-owned
unhandled tracebacks normalize to exception type and message; version, frame path, and line rendering are excluded
